The foundation of all vitaemantic craft, circles inscribed by the scribe's hand.
The Alchemy Array

Before sigils, before rituals, before the great workings of [#](4A0080)Vitaemancy[#]() were ever conceived, there was the [#](8B0000)Alchemy Array[#](). Inscribed with the [#](8B0000)Arcane Scribe Tool[#]() upon bare stone or earth, the array is the most fundamental expression of the art: a circle of intent, waiting to be given purpose.
The Alchemy Array

To inscribe an array, hold the [#](8B0000)Arcane Scribe Tool[#]() and press [Use] upon a solid surface. Each inscription consumes one charge; the tool holds twenty uses before wearing out.\
\
The empty array is inert. Click it with an item to place the [#](8B0000)base[#]() component. The design shifts if the base is recognized.

A second item placed becomes the [#](8B0000)catalyst[#](). If both are valid, the array awakens and its working begins. Both components are [#](8B0000)consumed[#]() as the array activates; nothing remains but the result of the working.\
\
[#](2E8B57)Watch the pattern carefully when you place the base. If the glyph changes form, you are on the right path.[#]()

The arrays catalogd in this chapter range from simple [#](8B0000)crafting arrays[#]() that reshape matter, to complex inscriptions that forge [#](4A0080)sigils[#](), bind [#](4A0080)sentient armor[#](), and even bend the passage of time. Master the fundamentals, and the rest shall follow.
The simplest array, inscribe essence onto matter and reshape it.
Crafting with Arrays

[#](8B0000)Crafting Arrays[#]() are among the simplest expressions of the art. The array inscribes the essence of the [#](8B0000)base[#]() onto the [#](8B0000)catalyst[#](), transmuting both into something new. A brief, elegant animation accompanies the transformation.
Crafting with Arrays

Some crafting arrays require only common materials. Others demand reagents forged through more advanced means; the complexity of the product mirrors the complexity of the path to reach it.\
\
[#](2E8B57)Most sigils, reagents, and bindings begin their existence within a crafting array. Master this foundation well.[#]()
Wards that repel foes and deflect projectiles.
Defensive Arrays

Where the Spike Array punishes intruders with pain, these arrays offer more sophisticated defenses.\
\
The [#](8B0000)Repulsion Array[#]() creates an invisible ward that pushes hostile creatures away in a 5-block radius. Anything that means you harm will find itself unable to approach.\
\
The [#](8B0000)Deflection Array[#]() projects a column of protective force above it, reflecting any projectile that passes through back the way it came.
Defensive Arrays

The Deflection Array requires an [#](8B0000)Tabula Animata[#]() and a diamond to inscribe, reflecting its advanced nature. It protects a column roughly 6 blocks tall and 3 blocks wide.\
\
The Repulsion Array needs only iron and lapis, making it accessible even to apprentice vitaemancers.\
\
[#](4A0080)The best defense is one your enemy never sees.[#]()
The armor craves combat; starve it of violence, and it starves you.
Battle Hungry

The armor develops a bloodlust that seeps into your belly. If you fail to attack something recently, gnawing hunger overtakes you. Higher levels shorten the grace period and intensify the starvation.\
\
[#](4A0080)The armor feeds on violence. Deny it, and it feeds on you instead.[#]()
Battle Hungry
The armor drags you down; water becomes a grave.
Concrete Shoes

The armor grows dense and waterlogged, dragging you down through liquid like an anchor. Reduces swim speed by up to 80%%.\
\
[#](4A0080)The depths call, and the armor answers on your behalf.[#]()
Concrete Shoes
The armor locks your off-hand; one arm must suffice.
Crippled Arm

The armor seizes your off-hand in a rigid grip, preventing you from using whatever you hold there. No torches, no shields, no secondary tools.\
\
[#](4A0080)The armor demands your undivided attention.[#]()
Crippled Arm
The armor festers, choking your body's ability to heal.
Diseased

The armor's living tissue sickens, suppressing your body's ability to mend. All healing is reduced by up to 80%%; a wound that should restore ten hearts barely returns two.\
\
[#](4A0080)What lives can also sicken.[#]()
Diseased
The armor bleeds your strength; every strike lands softer.
Dulled Blade

The armor saps the force behind your strikes, blunting every blow. Reduces melee damage by up to 80%%.\
\
[#](4A0080)Your sword arm weakens as the armor feeds elsewhere.[#]()
Dulled Blade
The armor drags at your arms; mining becomes a crawl.
Leadened Pick

The armor weighs upon your arms, making every swing of the pick feel like moving through tar. Reduces dig speed by up to 80%%.\
\
[#](4A0080)The stone mocks your feeble blows.[#]()
Leadened Pick
The armor hobbles your stride; each step heavier than the last.
Limp Leg

The armor stiffens around your legs, hobbling your stride. Reduces movement speed by up to 70%%.\
\
[#](B8860B)Maximum level[#](): 10\
\
[#](4A0080)Every step is a negotiation with the armor's weight.[#]()
Limp Leg
The armor seals your throat; no potion shall pass your lips.
Quenched

The armor rejects all liquid sustenance, clamping your throat shut against any potion you attempt to consume. No healing draughts, no buffs, no alchemical aids.\
\
[#](4A0080)The armor alone shall sustain you, or so it believes.[#]()
Quenched
The armor ruins your aim; every shot goes astray.
Storm Trooper

The armor interferes with your aim, introducing wild inaccuracy to every arrow and bolt you loose. Bows and crossbows become exercises in frustration.\
\
[#](4A0080)Your hands are steady. The armor is not.[#]()
Storm Trooper
Arrays that command weather, growth, and frost.
Environmental Arrays

These arrays reshape the world around them.\
\
The [#](8B0000)Tempest Array[#]() commands the weather, toggling rain on or off at a cost of 500 EV from the owner's soul network. Like the time arrays, it is consumed on use.\
\
The [#](8B0000)Growth Array[#]() coaxes nearby crops and plants to grow faster in a 2-block radius, applying a gentle acceleration each second.
Environmental Arrays

The [#](8B0000)Freeze Array[#]() reaches out to nearby water sources and converts them to ice, while covering exposed solid ground in a thin layer of snow. The effect spreads in a 3-block radius.\
\
Once the array has frozen everything in reach, it dissipates.\
\
[#](4A0080)The vitaemancer's will made manifest in frost and bloom.[#]()

The [#](8B0000)Undertow Array[#]() is scribed with [#](8B0000)Kelp[#]() and awakened by [#](8B0000)Redstone Dust[#](). Once active, it opens a [#](8B0000)vitaemantic current[#]() through the open column of air directly above the glyph, lifting or drowning any entity that enters, no water required.\
\
[#](8B0000)Right-click with an empty hand[#]() to reverse the flow. Upward currents push entities skyward; downward currents drag them to the bottom, mirroring a magma block's pull. The array is persistent and remembers its direction across world reloads.\
\
[#](8B0000)Scaling[#](): the strength of the current is read live from the array's own slots. Adding more [#](8B0000)Redstone Dust[#]() to the redstone slot strengthens the acceleration; adding more [#](8B0000)Kelp[#]() to the kelp slot raises the terminal velocity. Simply right-click the array with additional ingredients to stack them into place.\
\
[#](2E8B57)Tip: the Arcane Scribe Tool can inscribe arrays directly into water source blocks, so an Undertow Array can still be placed at the bottom of a pool without draining it first.[#]()
Rebinds a monster spawner to a creature slain beside it.
Array of Imprisonment

The [#](8B0000)Array of Imprisonment[#]() binds a wandering soul into stone. Inscribe it directly atop a [#](8B0000)Monster Spawner[#](), then slay a creature within an [#](8B0000)11x11x11[#]() region centered on the array.\
\
The spawner forgets its old charge and takes on the dying creature's nature instead. The glyph, its purpose fulfilled, crumbles to nothing.
Array of Imprisonment

Pair it with a [#](4A0080)Torment Nexus[#]() to grow a captive harvest of whatever quarry you choose. Reconfiguring a spawner is a one-time rite: to change it again, inscribe a fresh array.\
\
A few mighty creatures are too willful to be bound and the array ignores their passing.\
\
[#](4A0080)What dies near the cage becomes the cage.[#]()
Drains Tomes of Peritia into a tank, or fills them back from one.
Array of Liquified Experience

Learning is a fluid thing, and the [#](8B0000)Array of Liquified Experience[#]() proves it literally. Inscribe the glyph atop a chest and set a tank against it.\
\
Every [#](8B0000)Tome of Peritia[#]() resting in that chest is bled of what it holds, and the learning runs out as [#](4A0080)Liquified Experience[#]() into the waiting vessel.
Array of Liquified Experience

The tank may sit against the array or against the chest itself; the glyph finds it either way. It works once a second and cares nothing for whether you are watching.\
\
Feed the array a [#](8B0000)redstone signal[#]() and the current runs backwards: the tank is drained and the tomes drink it back down.\
\
[#](4A0080)Knowledge poured out is knowledge that can be poured back.[#]()

Neo Vitae brews its own [#](4A0080)Liquified Experience[#](), so the array needs nothing else installed to work.\
\
Should your world already hold another mod's experience fluid, name it in the server config under [#](8B0000)liquified_experience.preferred_fluid[#]() and the array will read and write that instead. The same section sets how many millibuckets a single point of experience is worth.
Summon and revive your tamed companions.
Array of Loyal Friends

The [#](8B0000)Array of Loyal Friends[#]() is a powerful restorative circle that calls all of your tamed companions to your side. Any living pet within range will be teleported to the array and ordered to follow you.\
\
More remarkably, the array reaches beyond death itself. Fallen pets are restored to full health at the array's location, though they lose any items they were carrying. The array costs [#](4A0080)5,000 EV[#]() from your soul network.
Array of Loyal Friends

Inscribe an [#](8B0000)Alchemy Array[#]() using a [#](4A0080)Lead[#]() as the base reagent and a [#](4A0080)Tabula Robur[#]() as the catalyst. Step near the active array to trigger the summoning. The nearest player within 8 blocks will be treated as the owner.
Inscribing the Array
Arrays of force, hurl creatures and objects with vitaemantic velocity.
Movement Arrays

A pair of arrays designed to hurl anything that crosses their threshold, players, creatures, loose items alike. One propels horizontally in the direction the entity faces; the other launches straight upward.
Movement Arrays

[#](8B0000)Speed Array[#](): Launches entities horizontally in the direction they face. Inscribed via [#](8B0000)Alchemy Array[#]().\
\
[#](8B0000)Updraft Array[#](): Hurls entities skyward with considerable force. Inscribed via [#](8B0000)Alchemy Array[#]().\
\
[#](2E8B57)Useful for rapid transit systems, mob processing, or simply entertaining oneself at a guest's expense.[#]()
Arrays that interface with redstone mechanisms.
Redstone Arrays

These arrays bridge the gap between vitaemancy and redstone engineering.\
\
The [#](8B0000)Signal Array[#]() outputs a redstone signal from 0 to 15, proportional to the Essentia Vitae stored in the owner's soul network. It scales linearly up to 1,000,000 EV. Requires a bound [#](8B0000)Arcane Ash[#]() to function.
Redstone Arrays

The [#](8B0000)Trigger Array[#]() emits a brief redstone pulse whenever a mob or player steps on it. The pulse lasts half a second, long enough for any standard redstone mechanism to detect.\
\
It functions much like a pressure plate, but is nearly invisible once inscribed.\
\
[#](4A0080)The blood knows who walks above it.[#]()
Armor that breathes, learns, and grows alongside its wearer.
Sentient Equipment

To create [#](8B0000)Sentient Equipment[#](), you require [#](8B0000)Iron Armor[#](), the [#](8B0000)Arcane Scribe Tool[#](), a [#](8B0000)Binding Reagent[#](), and at least a [#](8B0000)Common Spiritus Gem[#]() charged with sufficient [#](4A0080)Spiritus[#](). What emerges is no longer mere metal; it is alive, and it learns from you.
Sentient Equipment

The [#](8B0000)Binding Reagent[#]() is forged in the [#](8B0000)Tabula Vitae[#]().\
\
[#](8B0000)Sentient Equipment[#]() rivals [#](B8860B)Diamond[#]() in resilience and can be repaired in an [#](8B0000)Anvil[#]() with additional [#](8B0000)Binding Reagent[#]().

Inscribe an [#](8B0000)Alchemy Array[#](), then apply the [#](8B0000)Binding Reagent[#]() as base. Place your [#](8B0000)Iron Helmet[#](), [#](8B0000)Iron Chestplate[#](), [#](8B0000)Iron Leggings[#](), or [#](8B0000)Iron Boots[#]() as catalyst, and step back.\
\
The armor begins equivalent to iron, but possesses 100 [#](B8860B)Upgrade Points[#]() that it will spend as it grows alongside you. There may be ways to surpass this limitation...

The [#](8B0000)Ritual of Binding[#](): [#](8B0000)Binding Reagent[#]() as base, an iron armor piece as catalyst.\
\
The armor is alive, and it watches everything you do. Be deliberate in what you teach it. [#](2E8B57)Hold sneak while examining a piece to see what it has learned so far.[#]()
The armor learns from your deeds; guide its growth with care.
Sentient Upgrades

You have felt it, the armor shifting, adapting, straining to assist you in whatever task it observes. It grows in many directions at once, but its capacity is finite. Trying to master everything yields mastery of nothing.
Sentient Upgrades

Consider forging multiple sets, each trained for a specific purpose. A miner's set, a warrior's set, an explorer's set; specialization is the path to true power.\
\
You have devised [#](8B0000)Rituals[#]() to assist with focused training, and another to imbue your armor with a greater capacity for growth.

The armor banks experience toward a skill each time you perform the deed that teaches it, and advances a level once enough has gathered.\
\
[#](B8860B)By magnitude[#](): skills tied to harm, healing, knowledge, or travel learn in proportion to the event, the damage taken or dealt, the health mended, the experience gathered, the distance crossed. Greater deeds teach it faster.
How It Learns

[#](B8860B)By repetition[#](): skills like mining, or enduring fire and venom, learn a fixed measure each time, one mark per block broken, or one for every moment wreathed in flame or coursing with poison.\
\
Each skill rises at its own thresholds. A [#](8B0000)few[#]() are never taught through deeds at all, but inscribed directly from a Tome.
Command the wind to hurl you skyward, at your own peril.
Air Sigil

The [#](8B0000)Air Sigil[#]() hurls you through the sky in whatever direction you face, trading 50 [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() for each burst of momentum. The wind obeys, but gravity does not; this sigil offers no protection from the landing.\
\
[#](2E8B57)More than one overconfident apprentice has drained their [#](8B0000)Anima[#]() mid-flight. Know your reserves before you leap.[#]()
Air Sigil

Forge the [#](8B0000)Air Reagent[#]() in the [#](8B0000)Tabula Vitae[#](), then inscribe an [#](8B0000)Alchemy Array[#]() with the reagent as base and a slate as catalyst.\
\
[#](4A0080)The sky remembers every mage who forgot to look down.[#]()
Cast colored motes of blood-light into the darkness ahead of you.
Sigil of the Blood Lamp

The [#](8B0000)Sigil of the Blood Lamp[#]() launches a mote of crystallized [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() in the direction you face. When it strikes a surface, it anchors itself as a permanent floating light source at a cost of merely 10 [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]().\
\
Alternatively, right-clicking a nearby surface places the light directly without launching a projectile.
Sigil of the Blood Lamp

The sigil remembers a [#](8B0000)brightness level[#]() from 1 to 15. Left-click the air to cycle the brightness upward. Sneak and left-click to cycle it downward. The current setting is shown in the sigil's tooltip.\
\
Once a blood light has been placed, you can also adjust it directly. Right-click an existing blood light with an empty hand to increase its brightness, or sneak and right-click to dim it.
Brightness Control

Right-click a blood light with [#](8B0000)Redstone Dust[#]() to toggle redstone sensitivity. When enabled, the light will only emit light and particles while receiving a redstone signal. Without a signal, it goes dark.\
\
Right-click with redstone again to disable redstone control and return the light to its always-on state.
Redstone Control

Blood lights are not limited to their natural crimson. Combine the sigil with any vanilla [#](8B0000)dye[#]() in a shapeless craft to change its color. All other data on the sigil, including its binding and brightness setting, is preserved.\
\
Lights placed after dyeing will glow in the chosen color. To restore the default red, simply place the sigil alone in a crafting grid.
Color Dyeing

Forge the [#](8B0000)Blood Lamp Reagent[#]() in the [#](8B0000)Tabula Vitae[#](), then inscribe an [#](8B0000)Alchemy Array[#]() with the reagent as base and a slate as catalyst.\
\
[#](4A0080)A small light to banish the deepest dark, in any color you desire.[#]()
Access a linked container from anywhere in the world.
Sigil of Bound Treasures

The [#](8B0000)Sigil of Bound Treasures[#]() links to a container and allows you to access its contents from anywhere. [#](8B0000)Shift right-click[#]() a chest, barrel, or any other container to bind it to the sigil. Then [#](8B0000)right-click[#]() in the air to open the linked container remotely at a cost of [#](4A0080)200 EV[#]().\
\
The linked container must be in a loaded chunk to be accessed. If the container is destroyed, the link is broken.
Sigil of Bound Treasures
Inscribe an [#](8B0000)Alchemy Array[#]() with an [#](4A0080)Eye of Ender[#]() as the base and an [#](4A0080)Tabula Animata[#]() as the catalyst.
Crafting
A lens into the unseen, reveals the state of your Anima and Ara Vitae.
Divination Sigil

The [#](8B0000)Divination Sigil[#]() is the first lens through which a Vitaemancer peers into the invisible currents of [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() that sustain all vitaemantic works. Forged in an [#](8B0000)Alchemy Array[#]() from humble components, it reveals what the naked eye cannot.
Divination Sigil

Inscribe the array with [#](8B0000)Redstone Dust[#]() as the base and a [#](8B0000)Tabula Rasa[#]() as the catalyst. The sigil that emerges thrums faintly with awareness.\
\
[#](4A0080)To see is to begin understanding.[#]()

The sigil serves two vital purposes:

- Activate it toward open air to reveal the [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() stored within your [#](8B0000)Anima[#](), the measure of your reserves.

- Aim it at an [#](8B0000)Ara Vitae[#]() to reveal the altar's current tier, the volume of [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() within, and its maximum capacity.

Sigils fall into two schools of invocation:

- [#](8B0000)Use-on-cast[#]() sigils such as the [#](8B0000)Water[#](), [#](8B0000)Lava[#](), [#](8B0000)Void[#](), and [#](8B0000)Blood Lamp Sigils[#]() perform a single act each time you invoke them, drawing a fixed measure of [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() per use.

- [#](8B0000)Toggleable[#]() sigils maintain a continuous effect while held active. They draw [#](4A0080)EV[#]() at a steady upkeep so long as their power flows.
Sigil Activation

To toggle a sigil on or off, hold [#](8B0000)Shift[#]() and right-click into open air. Aiming at a block or creature will perform that sigil's normal action instead, so the shift requirement protects against accidental toggles in the heat of work.

An active toggleable sigil bears a faint enchantment shimmer, and its tooltip lists the [#](4A0080)EV[#]() it drains per interval. When your [#](8B0000)Anima[#]() runs dry, the sigil quietly deactivates until you refill and reignite it.

The toggleable sigils are:

- [#](8B0000)Sigil of the Green Grove[#]()

- [#](8B0000)Sigil of the Fast Miner[#]()

- [#](8B0000)Sigil of Magnetism[#]()

- [#](8B0000)Sigil of the Frozen Lake[#]()

- [#](8B0000)Sigil of Suppression[#]()

- [#](8B0000)Sigil of the Phantom Bridge[#]()

Hold sneak and press [Use] to open a configuration interface. Here you may reposition the various [#](4A0080)Vitaemancy[#]() display elements on your field of vision. Click and drag to move them, then select Save to preserve the arrangement, or Default to restore the original positions.

The configurable displays are:

- The Incense Altar (light gray)

- The Seer's Sigil (purple)

- The Divination Sigil (lavender)

- The Spiritus Aura Gauge (orange)

- The Sigil of Holding (green)

Press [#](4A0080)H[#]() (rebindable under Controls) to drag each display where you like.
Feed life into the soil and watch the world bloom around you.
Sigil of the Green Grove

The [#](8B0000)Sigil of the Green Grove[#]() channels [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() into the living earth, coaxing plants to grow with unnatural speed. A marriage of blood and botany that any practitioner with a garden will find indispensable.
Sigil of the Green Grove
Forge the [#](8B0000)Growth Reagent[#]() in the [#](8B0000)Tabula Vitae[#](), then inscribe an [#](8B0000)Alchemy Array[#]() with the reagent as base and a [#](8B0000)Tabula Robur[#]() as catalyst.

Aim at a growable block and press [Use] to apply a burst of growth for 150 [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]().\
\
Alternatively, hold sneak and press [Use] to toggle a persistent aura. While active, every block within a 7x7x5 volume centered on you receives a growth pulse every 5 seconds, at a cost of 150 [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() per cycle.
Carry five sigils in one, their power at your fingertips.
Sigil of Holding

The [#](8B0000)Sigil of Holding[#]() is a vessel within a vessel, capable of containing up to five other [#](8B0000)Sigils[#]() simultaneously. While held, it channels their passive effects and allows you to activate any of them at will.\
\
Press the Open Holding keybind to access its inventory. Use the cycle keybinds or hold sneak and scroll to switch between stored sigils.
Sigil of Holding

Forge the [#](8B0000)Holding Reagent[#]() in the [#](8B0000)Tabula Vitae[#](), then inscribe an [#](8B0000)Alchemy Array[#]() with the reagent as base and a slate as catalyst.\
\
[#](4A0080)One hand to hold the world's power.[#]()
Walk upon water made solid by the chill of your Anima.
Sigil of the Frozen Lake

The [#](8B0000)Sigil of the Frozen Lake[#]() chills the water beneath your feet as you walk, crystallizing it into solid ice within a two-block radius. The effect is reminiscent of ancient frost enchantments, but drawn from [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() rather than arcane inscriptions.\
\
Toggle it with sneak and [Use]. The ice endures only as long as you remain near.
Sigil of the Frozen Lake
Summon molten stone at a steep cost to your Anima.
Lava Sigil

Sister to the [#](8B0000)Water Sigil[#](), the [#](8B0000)Lava Sigil[#]() draws molten stone from the depths of your [#](8B0000)Anima[#]() at a cost of 1,000 [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#](). The price reflects the violence of the element, and if your reserves cannot bear it, five hearts are torn from your flesh instead.
Lava Sigil

Forge the [#](8B0000)Lava Reagent[#]() in the [#](8B0000)Tabula Vitae[#](), then inscribe an [#](8B0000)Alchemy Array[#]() with the reagent as base and a [#](8B0000)Tabula Rasa[#]() as catalyst.\
\
[#](4A0080)Handle with the reverence due to hellfire.[#]()

Like its cooler counterpart, the [#](8B0000)Lava Sigil[#]() may serve as a component in the [#](8B0000)Tabula Vitae[#]() to automate the production of [#](8B0000)Lava Buckets[#](). The sigil is not consumed.
Extend your reach; items drift toward you unbidden.
Sigil of Magnetism

The [#](8B0000)Sigil of Magnetism[#]() bends the subtle forces between you and nearby objects, extending your item pickup range to 7 blocks while active. Hold the sigil, then hold sneak and press [Use] to toggle the effect.\
\
The sigil drains 50 [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() every 5 seconds while its pull persists.
Sigil of Magnetism

Forge the [#](8B0000)Magnetism Reagent[#]() in the [#](8B0000)Tabula Vitae[#](), then inscribe an [#](8B0000)Alchemy Array[#]() with the reagent as base and a slate as catalyst.\
\
[#](4A0080)The world draws near to those who command it.[#]()
Blood-fueled haste for those who delve deep.
Sigil of the Fast Miner

The [#](8B0000)Sigil of the Fast Miner[#]() infuses your muscles with vitaemantic vigor, granting the Haste effect while active. Stone yields faster, timber falls quicker, earth parts more readily.\
\
Toggle with sneak and [Use]. Drains 100 [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() every 5 seconds while the effect persists.
Sigil of the Fast Miner

Forge the [#](8B0000)Mining Reagent[#]() in the [#](8B0000)Tabula Vitae[#](), then inscribe an [#](8B0000)Alchemy Array[#]() with the reagent as base and a [#](8B0000)Tabula Robur[#]() as catalyst.\
\
[#](4A0080)The earth parts before the blood-quickened hand.[#]()
Raise undead servants to fight alongside you.
Sigil of Necromancy

The [#](8B0000)Sigil of Necromancy[#]() calls upon the latent death in the world to raise an [#](4A0080)Undead Servant[#]() at the location you are aiming. Each use costs [#](4A0080)2,000 EV[#]() and summons one of four undead variants at random: a zombie, husk, skeleton, or stray.\
\
Servants last for 5 minutes before crumbling to dust, and will disappear if they stray too far from their master.
Sigil of Necromancy

Summoned undead are loyal to their creator. They will follow you when idle and automatically attack whatever target you last struck. They cannot harm their master, drop no loot or experience, and are immune to sunlight.\
\
To dismiss a servant early, [#](8B0000)shift right-click[#]() it while holding the sigil.
Servant Behavior

Unlike most sigils, the [#](8B0000)Sigil of Necromancy[#]() is forged in the [#](8B0000)Athanor[#]() rather than inscribed via alchemy array. Place a [#](4A0080)Tabula Robur[#](), [#](4A0080)Rotten Flesh[#](), and [#](4A0080)Bone[#]() in the input slots with a [#](8B0000)Resonator[#]() tool. Supply [#](4A0080)1,000 mB of Essentia Vitae[#]() and a minimum of [#](8B0000)20 Raw Spiritus[#]().

Walk upon crystallized EV, a bridge born of blood beneath your feet.
Sigil of the Phantom Bridge

The [#](8B0000)Sigil of the Phantom Bridge[#]() crystallizes [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() into temporary platforms beneath your feet as you walk. These spectral surfaces allow you to traverse chasms, voids, and open sky with the confidence of solid ground.\
\
The phantom blocks dissolve shortly after you leave them behind. [#](2E8B57)Keep moving; hesitation over the abyss is unwise.[#]()
Sigil of the Phantom Bridge

language_references.english: The pale foundation of a realm not meant for mortal eyes.
Demon Stone

The [#](4A0080)Demon Realm[#]() is built from a pale-blue material unknown to our world, a substance practitioners have taken to calling [#](8B0000)Demon Stone[#](). Its creation is deceptively simple: an infusion of ordinary stone with a measure of [#](4A0080)Spiritus[#](). Yet the result is something fundamentally alien.
Demon Stone
Consult JEI for the Demon Stone recipe.

A troubling property of this material: it is [#](4A0080)aggressively transmutative[#](). Any attempt to combine Demon Stone with ordinary stone simply yields more Demon Stone, as though the material hungers to convert all it touches. Consult JEI for the spread recipes.

Introducing stone to [#](4A0080)Ruina[#](), [#](4A0080)Nihilum[#](), [#](4A0080)Invictus[#](), or [#](4A0080)Vindicta[#]() Spiritus produces colored variants of Demon Stone, each carrying the faintest resonance of its aspect. All variants can be shaped in a stonecutter into various decorative patterns. Consult JEI for variant and spread recipes.
Colored Variants
A dark ore found only in the deepest tunnels of the Demon Realm.
Demonite

[#](8B0000)Demonite Ore[#]() exists only within [#](8B0000)The Mines[#]() of the Endless Realm, accessible after obtaining a [#](8B0000)Mine Entrance Key[#]() and unsealing the [#](4A0080)Spatial Distortion[#]() that guards the passage. This ore yields [#](8B0000)Hellforged Ingots[#]() or [#](8B0000)Hellforged Sand[#]() through various processing methods.\
\
[#](2E8B57)A Silk Touch enchantment harvests the ore block itself. Without it, you receive clumps of Raw Demonite.[#]()
Demonite
Both the raw ore and its mined clumps can be smelted into [#](8B0000)Hellforged Ingots[#](), the refined essence of demonic metallurgy. Consult JEI for these smelting recipes.
Hellforged Ingot
[#](8B0000)Hellforged Sand[#]() can be produced within the [#](8B0000)Athanor[#]() from gravel, ore, or raw demonite. This powdered form is essential for advanced potion-craft.
Hellforged Sand
The [#](8B0000)Athanor[#]() can further process demonite into fragments and gravel, offering multiple avenues to extract value from each piece of ore you wrest from the mines.
Demonite Processing
Consult JEI for the Raw Hellforged Block recipe.

Hellforged Blocks can be shaped in a [#](8B0000)stonecutter[#]() into variants faintly tainted with [#](4A0080)Ruina[#](), [#](4A0080)Nihilum[#](), [#](4A0080)Invictus[#](), or [#](4A0080)Vindicta[#]() Spiritus. Each decorative variant can be deconstructed back into 9 [#](8B0000)Hellforged Ingots[#]().
Decorative Variants
A tireless redstone pulse, born of demonic clockwork.
Dungeon Alternator

The [#](8B0000)Dungeon Alternator[#]() pulses with a ceaseless rhythm, emitting a redstone signal that oscillates between powered and dormant states at fixed intervals. It is the heartbeat of the realm's trap mechanisms, a [#](4A0080)demonic clockwork[#]() device of elegant simplicity.\
\
[#](2E8B57)These can be repurposed as compact redstone clocks in your own constructions. Consult JEI for the crafting recipe.[#]()
Luminous sentinels embedded in the walls of the Demon Realm.
Dungeon Eyes

Set into the walls of the [#](4A0080)Endless Realm[#](), the [#](8B0000)Dungeon Eye[#]() emits a pale, unwavering light. Whether these serve as sentinels or mere decoration is unclear; what is certain is that they illuminate the darkness with no fuel or flame.\
\
Variants exist tinted by [#](4A0080)Raw[#](), [#](4A0080)Ruina[#](), [#](4A0080)Nihilum[#](), [#](4A0080)Invictus[#](), and [#](4A0080)Vindicta[#]() Spiritus. Consult JEI for crafting recipes.
The heart of the Demon Realm, where darkness breeds treasure and peril in equal measure.
The Endless Realm

Where the Antechamber merely grazes the surface of the [#](4A0080)Demon Realm[#](), the [#](8B0000)Highway to Hell[#]() ritual tears the veil wide open. You emerge before another [#](8B0000)Inversion Pillar[#](), but the air here is thicker, the shadows deeper. A lone chest awaits, left by some prior explorer who did not leave by choice, and doorways branch outward into the labyrinth beyond.
The Endless Realm

A second [#](8B0000)Inversion Pillar[#]() stands ready to return you home. Use it wisely; the creatures that dwell here are far more formidable than those of the Antechamber, and the rewards they guard are proportionally greater.\
\
As you explore, the realm will warn you of your progress. Listen for ominous messages and watch for [#](8B0000)Spatial Distortions[#](); they herald the path to the mines.

The deeper you delve, the more the realm stirs. After exploring several rooms, you will receive a warning: [#](4A0080)"Strange noises and creatures begin to stir in the depths..."[#]() This signals that a [#](8B0000)Spatial Distortion[#]() has appeared somewhere in the dungeon, marked by dark tendrils of void energy and an ominous sound.\
\
Press deeper still and a second warning echoes: [#](4A0080)"A monstrous roar echoes through the corridors..."[#]() The [#](8B0000)Foreman's[#]() chamber has manifested.
Dungeon Progression

[#](4A0080)Spatial Distortions[#]() are fractures in the architecture of the realm. When a room harboring one is unsealed, dark void tendrils erupt from its center and a message appears on your screen. These distortions conceal two things: the entrance to [#](8B0000)The Mines[#]() and the sealed chamber of the [#](8B0000)Foreman[#]().
Spatial Distortions

The mine entrance is no empty passage. Within lurks [#](8B0000)The Foreman[#](), a greatly empowered [#](8B0000)Daemonium Doloris[#]() that serves as guardian of the mines. This boss-tier creature is far stronger than its lesser kin, boasting immense health, devastating attacks, and a visible boss bar.\
\
Defeat The Foreman and he surrenders a clutch of [#](8B0000)Mine Dungeon Keys[#](), the only keys that open the deeper mine tunnels. His chamber, like the mine entrance itself, is sealed behind a [#](8B0000)Mine Entrance Key[#]().
The Foreman
Only a Mine Dungeon Key will open the sealed passage into the deeper workings. If you have not yet defeated The Foreman, you must venture back.

When every sealed doorway in the dungeon has been opened or collapsed, a [#](8B0000)Spatial Rift[#]() tears open near the exit portal. Dark tendrils of blood energy radiate outward from the fracture.\
\
Step into the rift to be transported to a [#](4A0080)brand new Endless Realm[#]() dungeon. A return portal in the new dungeon leads back to the previous one, and the standard [#](8B0000)Inversion Pillar[#]() always takes you home to the overworld. This process can repeat infinitely; each rift leads deeper into the realm.
The Spatial Rift

Beyond the sealed passage lie [#](8B0000)The Mines[#](), a [#](B8860B)significant escalation[#]() in both peril and plunder. Veins of [#](8B0000)Demonite Ore[#]() thread through the walls here, essential for advanced potion-craft and the construction of the [#](B8860B)Tier-5 Ara Vitae[#]() and its accompanying Orb. Alongside the ore, you will find enchanted armaments, anointments, potions, and other spoils worthy of the risk.
The Mines

Delve deep enough and fortune may smile upon you with [#](8B0000)Intricate Hellforged Parts[#](). These rare components can be used to [#](4A0080)double the potency[#]() of your existing [#](8B0000)Runes[#](), effectively granting the power of two Ara Vitaes in a single structure.

Beyond that threshold broods the [#](8B0000)Foreman[#](); fell him and he surrenders a clutch of [#](8B0000)Mine Dungeon Keys[#](), the only keys that breach the deeper workings, where [#](8B0000)Demonite Ore[#]() and rare plunder await.

A [#](8B0000)Simple Dungeon Key[#]() is forged in the [#](8B0000)Hellfire Forge[#]() from a pair of [#](8B0000)Iron Ingots[#]() and a pinch of [#](8B0000)Corrupted Dust[#](). One wonders why the demons never thought to simply pick the locks.

The Antechamber

When the [#](8B0000)Breaching the Edge of Demon Realm[#]() ritual completes, you will find yourself standing before an [#](8B0000)Inversion Pillar[#](). Touch it, and you are drawn across the threshold into the [#](4A0080)Antechamber[#](), the outermost vestibule of the [#](4A0080)Demon Realm[#]().\
\
Take stock of your surroundings:

- A solitary chest, sometimes containing [#](8B0000)Simple Dungeon Keys[#]().
The Antechamber

- Several [#](8B0000)Doorways[#](), each barred by a [#](8B0000)Dungeon Seal[#](). Present a key to a seal to unseal the chamber beyond.

- A second [#](8B0000)Inversion Pillar[#](), mirroring the one that summoned you. This is your lifeline home.\
\
[#](2E8B57)The stonework here is unique to the Demon Realm. If its aesthetics appeal to you, help yourself.[#]()

Each sealed chamber you open may contain treasure, hostile denizens, traps, or dormant rituals. Vigilance is the price of survival here.\
\
Among the spoils you may claim:

- Enchanted Books

- Enchanted Weapons and Armor

- Various Anointments

- Spiritus

- Potion Ingredients

- Tau Fruit

- Saturated Tau

- Tau Oil\
\
[#](2E8B57)The Antechamber is merely a foretaste. Prove yourself here, and the deeper reaches of the realm will open to you in time.[#]()
Phantom blocks that wear the faces of others.
Ethereal Mimics

[#](8B0000)Ethereal Mimics[#]() are blocks of a curious [#](4A0080)liminal[#]() nature. They adopt the appearance of any block presented to them, yet remain completely intangible, as though they exist only partially in our reality. This makes them ideal for concealing pitfall traps, hidden passages, and secret chambers.\
\
You may encounter them within the [#](8B0000)Endless Realm[#](), where they were clearly put to devious use.
Ethereal Mimics

[#](2E8B57)Right-click a placed Ethereal Mimic with any block to assign it that block's appearance. It will look solid to the eye but offer no resistance to passage.[#]()\
\
Consult JEI for the crafting recipe.
Dormant blades that awaken at a redstone whisper.
Spike Trap

[#](8B0000)Spike Traps[#]() sit dormant and deceptively innocuous until a redstone signal reaches them, whereupon serrated blades erupt from their housing with lethal intent. Whatever [#](4A0080)intelligence[#]() designed these was clearly determined to discourage uninvited guests.\
\
[#](2E8B57)Clever practitioners have repurposed these for their own defenses. Consult JEI for the crafting recipe.[#]()

When a powered spike trap [#](8B0000)slays a creature[#](), the spilled vitality is not lost. Place an [#](8B0000)Ara Vitae[#]() within sixteen blocks and the kill will feed it directly, mimicking the [#](4A0080)Well of Suffering[#]() at roughly [#](8B0000)one third[#]() of its yield. The trap remembers the nearest altar after the first kill and re-scans only when that altar is broken or relocated.\
\
[#](2E8B57)Players are immune to this harvest[#]() - the spikes will wound you, but they will not feed your altar from your blood, nor will their kills be credited to any practitioner. No experience, no player-only drops. A reliable [#](8B0000)pre-ritual mob farm[#]() for vitaemancers who have not yet mastered the true ritual circles.
The Lesser Tithe
A parasitic fruit of the Demon Realm, nourished by the living.
Tau Fruit

[#](8B0000)Tau Fruit[#]() is first encountered growing wild in the [#](4A0080)Simple Dungeons[#]() of the Demon Realm. Once harvested, it can be cultivated, though as a native growth of that accursed place, its lifecycle is far more demanding than any mundane crop.\

Left to mature under ordinary conditions, it ripens into common [#](8B0000)Tau Fruit[#](), which can be refined into [#](8B0000)Tau Oil[#]().
Tau Fruit

[#](8B0000)Tau Oil[#]() is rendered from its fruit upon the [#](8B0000)Tabula Vitae[#](). It carries a scent reminiscent of blood oranges, though with an unmistakable undertone of something decidedly otherworldly.
Tau Oil

Tau Oil serves two principal purposes in Vitaemancy:

- It extends the duration of any [#](8B0000)anointment[#]() by a factor of four.

- It is a key ingredient in [#](8B0000)Intermediate Cutting Fluid[#](), which functions like its basic counterpart but endures eight times longer and provides a 25%% speed boost.

There exists a darker method of cultivation. If a [#](4A0080)living creature[#]() stands atop the plant as it matures, the Tau vine will draw upon the creature's vitality to feed its own growth. The result is [#](8B0000)Saturated Tau[#](), a far more potent variant born from stolen life.

language_references.english: Inscribing circles of power upon the world.
The Art of Ritual

When your [#](8B0000)Ara Vitae[#]() reaches [#](B8860B)Tier 2[#](), the boundaries of [#](4A0080)Vitaemancy[#]() expand dramatically. You gain access to [#](4A0080)Rituals[#](), vast sigil-circles that channel your [#](4A0080)Anima[#]() into sustained, powerful effects upon the world itself.\
\
To perform a ritual, you require:

- An [#](8B0000)Activation Crystal[#](). At [#](B8860B)Tier 2[#](), only the [#](8B0000)Weak Crystal[#]() is available.

- A [#](8B0000)Master Ritual Stone[#](). Every ritual demands exactly one at its heart.
The Art of Ritual

- Sufficient [#](8B0000)Ritual Stones[#]() to form the pattern.

- A [#](8B0000)Ritual Diviner[#]() (strongly recommended). While not strictly necessary, it simplifies construction immensely.\
\
[#](2E8B57)Press Sneak + Use with the Diviner in hand to cycle through available rituals. Check rune requirements by hovering over it in your inventory while sneaking.[#]()

Place a [#](8B0000)Master Ritual Stone[#](), then hold Use with the Diviner aimed at it until every stone has been placed and inscribed with the correct element.\
\
Finally, press Use on the [#](8B0000)Master Ritual Stone[#]() with your [#](8B0000)Activation Crystal[#]() in hand. If the circle is complete, you will feel a rush of energy; the ritual awakens.

If instead you feel a push but are too weak, your [#](4A0080)Anima[#]() lacks the [#](8B0000)Essentia Vitae[#]() needed for activation. Fill your reserves and try again.\
\
If the runes feel misconfigured, something obstructs or misaligns the pattern. Clear the area of blockages and reassemble the circle with care.

Remember that some rituals extend several blocks above and below the [#](8B0000)Master Ritual Stone[#](). If nothing happens at all, ensure the crystal is bound to an [#](4A0080)Anima[#](); press Use while holding it to bind it to yours.\
\
[#](2E8B57)A crystal need not be bound to your own Anima. If you acquire another Vitaemancer's crystal, you can activate rituals using their EV. Guard yours well.[#]()

One final note: all rituals respond to a [#](8B0000)redstone[#]() signal. A lever on the [#](8B0000)Master Ritual Stone[#]() provides a simple means of silencing it. Combine this with redstone automation to ensure your rituals shut down before your [#](4A0080)Anima[#]() runs dry.
Reaps grown animals while sparing a breeding stock.
Ritual of Butchering
[#](2E8B57)Built from standard runes; any Ritual Diviner will serve.[#]()

The circle reaps the grown beasts within its bounds and gathers their spoils into a chest set above the Master Ritual Stone. It is no wanton slaughter, however: it counts the herd by species and stays its hand while too few of a kind remain, so a breeding stock always survives.\
\
Set how many of each species to spare with the [#](8B0000)Ritual Configurator[#](); right-click the stone and adjust the [#](8B0000)Keep per species[#]() dial.
The Culling

Lay this circle over the same ground as a [#](8B0000)Ritual of the Shepherd[#]() and the two sustain one another endlessly. The Shepherd grows the young and breeds the grown; the Butchering reaps the surplus and spares your chosen breeding stock. Stock the chest, walk away, and return to a full larder of meat, leather, and more, with the flock none the smaller for it.

The Torment Nexus

[#](2E8B57)Use a Ritual Diviner [Tenebrae] for easier construction.[#]()\
\
Requires an [#](8B0000)Awakened Activation Crystal[#]() to start.

On a populated server, [#](8B0000)the Well of Suffering[#]() strains under the weight of every player's mob farm. Dozens or hundreds of mobs spawned, killed, and dropped at once, each dragging the tick rate down a little further.\
\
[#](4A0080)The Torment Nexus[#]() exists so endgame practitioners can extract the same EV stream without spawning a single mob. The kills are simulated. The chunks stay quiet. The server stays playable.
Why It Exists

On activation the ritual binds every [#](8B0000)mob spawner[#]() and [#](8B0000)trial spawner[#]() inside its working area (default 11x11x11, configurable). For each bound spawner it reads the cadence and mob roster the spawner already has, then every second it [#](4A0080)imagines[#]() the mobs the spawner would have spawned and processes each as a kill:\
\
Real spawning is [#](2E8B57)suppressed[#]() entirely.\
EV is paid out of the network and deposited into the nearest Ara Vitae.\
Loot tables are rolled and inserted into a chest atop the Master Ritual Stone.\
XP from each kill is fed into an [#](8B0000)Experience Tome[#]() in that same chest, if one is present.
How It Operates

The Nexus harvests whatever the bound spawners are set to spawn, so the roster is yours to decide. To retune a spawner, inscribe an [#](8B0000)Array of Imprisonment[#]() atop it and slay the creature you want within an [#](8B0000)11x11x11[#]() region of the array; the spawner takes on that creature and the array is spent.\
\
Stock a ring of spawners around the Nexus this way to farm exactly the drops you need without a single mob ever drawing breath.
Choosing the Quarry

Long before our generation, the elder vitaemancers warned in their journals of a working they called [#](4A0080)the Torment Nexus[#](): a circle that would render every bound horror's death real enough to harvest, but unreal enough to require no body.\
\
They were quite explicit. [#](8B0000)Do not build the Torment Nexus[#](), they wrote.\
\
At long last, we have built the Torment Nexus from the classic warning [#](4A0080)Do Not Build the Torment Nexus[#](). The TPS gains are excellent.
On the Ethics

Two server-config knobs balance the ritual:\
\
[#](8B0000)ev_per_kill[#](): EV deducted from your network per simulated kill (default 75).\
[#](8B0000)ev_modifier_percent[#](): scales the EV deposited per kill from 1 (1%%) to 1000 (10x). Pack authors can crank this down to make the ritual a quality-of-life replacement for old farms, or up to make it a true endgame multiplier.\
\
Range can be tuned with the [#](2E8B57)Ritual Configurator[#]() per ritual stone.

Yet these raw crystals feel somehow... [#](4A0080)conflicted[#](), as though warring natures strain against one another within.\
\
A focused mote of pure animus, paired with the right [#](8B0000)Spiritus Catalyst[#](), can coax these hidden facets into purer forms.
Aspects of Spiritus

The four distinct [#](4A0080)Aspects[#]() of Spiritus:

- [#](8B0000)Spiritus Invictus[#](): the unbroken; a fortress of intent that refuses to be undone.

- [#](8B0000)Spiritus Nihilum[#](): the final silence; weight without haste, an ending given form.

- [#](8B0000)Spiritus Vindicta[#](): the swift reckoning; vengeance taken before the offense is voiced.

- [#](8B0000)Spiritus Ruina[#](): the slow undoing; patient decay that wears all things to ruin.\
\
Each Aspect can be burned in the [#](8B0000)Vas Maleficum[#]() just as Raw Spiritus can, feeding the [#](8B0000)Aura[#]() with its particular resonance for your Rituals to draw upon.

Each Aspect also transforms the behavior of your [#](8B0000)Sentient Tools[#]():

- [#](8B0000)Raw Spiritus[#](): Pure damage increase.

- [#](8B0000)Spiritus Ruina[#](): Strikes may inflict poison or wither. Otherwise identical to Raw.

- [#](8B0000)Spiritus Vindicta[#](): Moderate damage increase, heightened attack speed, and a movement speed boon that intensifies with greater Spiritus reserves.
Sentient Tool Aspects

- [#](8B0000)Spiritus Invictus[#](): Moderate damage increase, and slaying a foe grants you a protective shield of Absorption.

- [#](8B0000)Spiritus Nihilum[#](): The greatest raw damage of any Aspect, at the cost of reduced attack speed.

To fill a [#](8B0000)Spiritus Gem[#]() with a specific Aspect, feed a [#](8B0000)Vas Maleficum[#]() Spiritus Crystals of that Aspect until the chunk's Aura runs thick with it. Then set the empty gem in that same Vas and [#](2E8B57)apply a redstone signal[#](); the vessel reverses its flow, and the gem drinks deeply from the Aura.\
\
[#](2E8B57)Right-click while holding a Sentient Tool to recalibrate it to the dominant Aspect in your inventory.[#]()

A gem holds but one Aspect at a time, and an empty one seizes upon whichever the Aura offers first. Where several mingle, they are taken in a fixed precedence: [#](8B0000)Raw[#]() before all others, then Ruina, Nihilum, Invictus, and Vindicta last.\
\
[#](2E8B57)Dedicate a separate chunk to each Aspect you mean to bottle. The faintest trace of Raw will claim the vessel before any other Aspect is so much as considered.[#]()

Your [#](8B0000)Sentient Tools[#]() attune to whichever Aspect you carry in greatest quantity. Ten Spiritus Ruina in one [#](8B0000)Spiritus Gem[#]() and a thousand Raw in another means the blade remains Raw.\
\
[#](2E8B57)The Hellfire Forge accepts any Aspect of Spiritus for crafting, so there is no need to juggle multiple gems between stations.[#]()
The alchemist's crucible: smelter, ore tripler, and instrument of unmaking.
The Athanor

The [#](8B0000)Athanor[#]() is the alchemist's furnace, a vessel of transmutation that transcends mere smelting. Within its crucible you may triple ore yields, revert Orbs of Vitae, unmake Netherite and Reinforced Runes, and - most critically - distill [#](8B0000)Weak Blood Shards[#]() from [#](8B0000)Saturated Tau[#]().\
\
[#](2E8B57)Most tools placed in the Athanor degrade over time, but Unbreaking or Mending enchantments will slow or halt their decay.[#]()
The Athanor

Forged within the Hellfire Forge, the [#](8B0000)Sanguine Reverter[#]() is a tool of [#](4A0080)unmaking[#](). It peels away the enchantments of creation, reducing Orbs of Vitae, Netherite, and Reinforced Runes back to their constituent materials. It is also the instrument by which Weak Blood Shards are born from Saturated Tau.
The Sanguine Reverter

With the Sanguine Reverter, the Athanor can unmake:

- [#](8B0000)Novicius Orb of Vitae[#]()
- [#](8B0000)Discipulus Orb of Vitae[#]()
- [#](8B0000)Veneficus Orb of Vitae[#]()
- [#](8B0000)Magus Orb of Vitae[#]()
- Netherite Ingot
- Any Reinforced Rune (to base materials)
Recipes of Reversion

Every Reinforced Rune placed in the Athanor alongside the Sanguine Reverter surrenders its form and returns to base materials. This is invaluable when restructuring your altar, apprentice - no investment need be permanent.
Reclaiming Runes

With the [#](8B0000)Sanguine Reverter[#]() in the tool slot, the Athanor also [#](4A0080)disenchants[#](). Load a stack of [#](8B0000)Books[#]() alongside a single enchanted item - armor, a tool, or even an [#](8B0000)Enchanted Book[#]() - and the crucible lifts one enchantment at a time onto a fresh book, removing it from the item.\
\
Each enchantment moved costs [#](8B0000)5 Raw Spiritus[#]() and [#](8B0000)100 mB of Essentia Vitae[#](). Once the item is stripped bare it drops to the output. The work continues only while you have books to fill and room in the output to hold them.
Stripping Enchantments

The Athanor is sensitive to the [#](4A0080)Raw Spiritus[#]() saturating the surrounding chunk. With no spiritus present, the crucible operates at [#](8B0000)half speed[#](). As raw spiritus builds toward 100, the Athanor accelerates, reaching [#](8B0000)double speed[#]() at full saturation.\
\
The crucible also has a small appetite: while actively crafting, there is a [#](8B0000)5%% chance each second[#]() that the Athanor consumes 1 raw spiritus from the chunk. Sustained operation will slowly deplete the local reserves.\
\
[#](2E8B57)Keep Demon Crystals growing nearby to replenish what the Athanor consumes.[#]()
Spiritus and the Athanor

Certain advanced recipes also require a specific amount of spiritus in the chunk to craft. The Athanor's interface shows a gauge with the current spiritus levels; a red overlay marks how much is needed. If the chunk lacks sufficient will, the Athanor stalls and emits dark particles until the deficit is replenished.\
\
[#](2E8B57)Spiritus costs are consumed on craft completion, not during progress.[#]()
Spiritus-Infused Recipes

[#](2E8B57)The Athanor is sided, much like a common furnace. Tools may only enter or exit from the top. Inputs are accepted from the sides. Outputs emerge from the bottom.[#]()\
\
Keep this geometry in mind when placing your Hoppers or Routing Nodes. An automated Athanor is the heart of any serious ore-processing chain.
Automating the Athanor
Saturating the world with demonic intent through the Vas Maleficum.
The Spiritus Aura

[#](4A0080)Demonic Spiritus[#]() coalesces naturally around certain creatures, but it can also exist in a diffused state throughout the very air. By burning Spiritus in a [#](8B0000)Vas Maleficum[#](), you release it into the [#](4A0080)Aura[#](), an invisible miasma that permeates each chunk of the world, ripe for exploitation.
The Spiritus Aura

Feed it a charged [#](8B0000)Spiritus Gem[#](), loose [#](8B0000)Spiritus[#](), or [#](8B0000)Spiritus Crystals[#]() of any Aspect. Crystals are consumed once the chunk's Spiritus dips below 50; Spiritus in item form or from a gem is consumed gradually as needed.\
\
[#](2E8B57)Apply a redstone signal[#]() and the Vas reverses: a Spiritus Gem placed inside is now [#](2E8B57)filled[#]() from the chunk's Aura instead of drained. The same vessel serves as both deposit and withdrawal point.
Vas Maleficum
The [#](8B0000)Vas Maleficum[#]() with a [#](8B0000)Spiritus Gem[#]() smoldering within.

With Raw Spiritus now saturating the atmosphere, certain [#](8B0000)Rituals[#]() stir to greater potency. The true prize, however, is the ability to grow [#](8B0000)Spiritus Crystals[#]() and from there, split them into their constituent [#](8B0000)Aspects[#]().\
\
Once you possess [#](8B0000)Aspected Spiritus Crystals[#](), burn them in the [#](8B0000)Vas Maleficum[#]() to flood the Aura with their particular resonance.

[#](2E8B57)The Aura is chunk-based.[#]() Spiritus burned in one chunk fills only that chunk, up to a cap of [#](B8860B)100[#]() for each Aspect. Measure the local concentration with a [#](8B0000)Spiritus Aura Gauge[#]().\
\
To move Spiritus across distances, place a [#](8B0000)Spira Infernalis[#](). It draws Spiritus toward itself from 16 blocks away in each cardinal direction, and multiple pylons can be chained for long-distance transfer.

The pylon probes a position [#](B8860B)16 blocks away[#]() in each of the four cardinal directions (no diagonals, no vertical). If a probed position holds more Spiritus than the pylon's own chunk does, the pylon pulls a small fraction of the difference per tick. The flow equilibrates rather than draining the source dry, so place pylons in a [#](2E8B57)chain[#]() from a saturated chunk toward your worksite to ferry Aura over long distances.
Spira Infernalis

This reversal is how an aspected gem is made. Saturate a chunk with a single Aspect, leave an empty [#](8B0000)Spiritus Gem[#]() in a redstone-charged [#](8B0000)Vas Maleficum[#]() there, and it takes on that Aspect as it fills.\
\
An aspected gem reshapes the behavior of your [#](8B0000)Sentient Tools[#]() and [#](8B0000)Sword[#](). The effects of each Aspect are detailed in the [#](8B0000)Aspects of Spiritus[#]() entry.

Blood Mending

Through the [#](8B0000)Hellfire Forge[#](), a practitioner can bind the restorative power of [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() directly into their equipment. An item imbued with [#](8B0000)Blood Mending[#]() will slowly knit itself back together, drawing [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() from the wielder's [#](8B0000)Soul Network[#]() each second.\
\
The enchantment requires a bound [#](8B0000)Orb of Vitae[#]() somewhere in the practitioner's inventory and sufficient reserves in their network to function. Only worn armor and held items benefit from this effect.
Blood Mending

Place the item to enchant in the [#](8B0000)Hellfire Forge[#]() alongside a [#](4A0080)Tabula Robur[#](), [#](4A0080)Lapis Lazuli[#](), and [#](4A0080)Nether Wart[#](). The forge requires a minimum of [#](8B0000)400 Spiritus[#]() and will consume [#](8B0000)200 Spiritus[#]() in the process.\
\
The item will retain all of its existing enchantments and properties.
Applying Blood Mending
A portable reservoir for Essentia Vitae and other vital fluids.
Blood Tank

The [#](8B0000)Blood Tank[#]() is a portable reservoir, capable of holding [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#]() and other fluids. Fill or drain it by right-clicking with a bucket or similar vessel. The tank faithfully retains its contents when broken, making it ideal for transporting large volumes between locations.\
\
It glows faintly according to its contents. Each tier doubles the previous capacity, beginning at [#](B8860B)16 Buckets[#]() and reaching a staggering [#](B8860B)524,288 Buckets[#]() at tier 16.
Blood Tank

Combine two [#](8B0000)Blood Tanks[#]() with [#](8B0000)Glass[#]() and a [#](8B0000)Bloodstone[#]() in a crafting table. The resulting tank rises one tier above the primary input, and both tanks' fluid contents merge together.\
\
If both tanks hold the same fluid, volumes are added. If only one contains fluid, the result retains it. If they hold different fluids, the primary tank's contents take precedence.
Reinforcing the Vessel
[#](2E8B57)Each tier doubles the previous tier's capacity, so reinforce early and often. A few tiers of upgrading can mean the difference between a trickle and a torrent.[#]()

Stone steeped in life force - decorative, and essential for the fourth Ara Vitae tier.
Bloodstone Bricks

[#](8B0000)Bloodstone Bricks[#]() are stone saturated with crystallized life force, dark and warm to the touch. Beyond their unsettling beauty, they serve as the [#](B8860B)capstones for the Tier III Ara Vitae[#]().\
\
Their creation requires [#](8B0000)Weak Blood Shards[#](), obtained by placing [#](8B0000)Saturated Tau[#]() into the Athanor with a Sanguine Reverter.
Bloodstone Bricks
Condensing raw malice from the Aura into physical crystal.
Crystallized Spiritus

Now that your [#](8B0000)Spiritus Gem[#]() brims with [#](8B0000)Spiritus[#](), you may wonder what happens when that malice is unleashed upon the world itself. The answer begins with saturating the [#](8B0000)Aura[#](), and continues with the [#](8B0000)Crystallarium Maleficum[#]().
Crystallized Spiritus

Place it with open air above, and the Crystallarium [#](2E8B57)seeds the first spire[#]() of a [#](8B0000)Spiritus Crystal[#]() cluster once the chunk's Aura holds at least [#](B8860B)99 Spiritus[#]() of any single Aspect. The spire formed will be the chunk's [#](2E8B57)dominant Aspect[#](). After the first spire stands, the [#](8B0000)Spiritus Crystal[#]() grows under its own power; the Crystallarium has done its work.\
\
A cluster may grow up to [#](B8860B)7 spires[#]() tall.
Crystallarium Maleficum

Spires grow whenever the chunk holds at least a trace of the cluster's Aspect; growth scales with saturation, accelerating as the Aura fills. A chunk's natural cap is [#](B8860B)100[#]() per Aspect, though certain Rituals can raise it.\
\
Each new spire costs [#](B8860B)45 Spiritus[#]() when the chunk's dominant Aspect matches the cluster, and yields 50 when burned in a Vas Maleficum, a net gain of 5 per spire. If the chunk's dominant Aspect [#](2E8B57)does not match[#]() the cluster (for instance, a Raw chunk feeding a Ruina cluster), the cost rises to [#](B8860B)90 Spiritus[#]() per spire and growth runs at [#](B8860B)60%% speed[#](). Keep the chunk biased toward the Aspect you want to farm.
Spire Growth

If you carry more than [#](B8860B)512 total Spiritus[#]() in your inventory (across any number of [#](8B0000)Spiritus Gems[#](), of any single type), you may harvest these crystals by right-clicking the cluster with an empty hand. This strips all but the central spire.\
\
[#](2E8B57)In a hurry, or desperate for that last crystal? A pickaxe will shatter the entire cluster at once.[#]()

Manual harvest yields a modest five Spiritus per cluster. To industrialise crystal production, build the [#](8B0000)Crystallum Fractura[#]() ritual: it auto-harvests every fully-grown cluster in range, doubles crystal growth speed, and amplifies any Spiritus injection by +25%%. To bootstrap aspected lineages, apply a [#](8B0000)Spiritus Catalyst[#]() (one per aspect) to a fully-grown Raw cluster; the catalyst consumes one [#](8B0000)Animus Mote[#]() and transmutes the cluster into its target Aspect. See the Spiritus Catalysts entry for the full loop.
Compact demolition devices fueled by Spiritus and enhanced by anointment.
Explosive Charges

Mining by hand and felling trees one swing at a time; such drudgery is beneath a practitioner of [#](4A0080)Vitaemancy[#](). You have devised something far more elegant: compact charges of compressed Spiritus that detonate on contact. Hurl them at offending stone, timber, or anything else you wish unmade, and wait for the satisfying ignition.
Explosive Charges

Each charge can be further enhanced by [#](8B0000)Anointing[#]() it with certain reagents and a measure of Spiritus:

- [#](B8860B)Fortunate[#](): broken blocks yield Fortune loot.

- [#](B8860B)Heated Tool[#](): broken blocks are smelted on the spot.

- [#](B8860B)Soft Touch[#](): broken blocks are affected by Silk Touch.

- [#](B8860B)Voiding[#](): worthless debris is annihilated rather than dropped.

Obliterates a [#](B8860B)5x5x5[#]() cube on the face it strikes, dropping all blocks as though mined with a pickaxe. It cuts through Obsidian with ease and provides a most gratifying concussion.\
\
Anointable: Voiding, Heated Tool, Soft Touch, Fortunate.
Shaped Charge

A direct improvement. Destroys a [#](B8860B)7x7x7[#]() cube on the impacted face, and may be anointed with [#](B8860B)Fortune II[#]() as well.\
\
Anointable: Voiding, Heated Tool, Soft Touch, Fortunate, Fortunate II.
Augmented Shaped Charge

Bores a [#](B8860B)5x5x20[#]() corridor straight through whatever it strikes. An invaluable companion for deep excavation.\
\
Anointable: Voiding, Heated Tool, Soft Touch, Fortunate, Fortunate II.
Tunnelling Shaped Charge

Purpose-built for timber. Strike a log or leaf block, and up to [#](B8860B)two stacks[#]() of wood come crashing down, with leaves stripped away in the process. Even the mightiest jungle giants fall in moments.\
\
Anointable: Voiding, Heated Tool, Soft Touch, Fortunate.
Deforester Charge

The greater variant. Fells up to [#](B8860B)8 stacks[#]() of logs, shearing away all connecting leaves. Ideal for carving clearings in Dark Oak forests or dense jungles.\
\
Anointable: Voiding, Heated Tool, Soft Touch, Fortunate, Fortunate II.
Deforester Charge II

Destroys only blocks [#](B8860B)identical to the block it strikes[#](), seeking outward from the point of impact. Consumes up to 3 stacks of matching blocks.\
\
Anointable: Voiding, Heated Tool, Soft Touch, Fortunate.
Controlled Charge

Functions identically to the standard Controlled Charge, but devours up to [#](B8860B)8 stacks[#]() of matching blocks.\
\
Anointable: Voiding, Heated Tool, Soft Touch, Fortunate, Fortunate II.
Controlled Charge II

Designed for the great mushrooms of the Overworld and the Nether. Capable of consuming up to [#](B8860B)three stacks[#]() of fungal material, though you would be hard-pressed to find a specimen that large.\
\
Anointable: Voiding, Heated Tool, Soft Touch, Fortunate.
Fungal Charge

The greater fungal variant. Annihilates up to [#](B8860B)8 stacks[#]() of mushroom material in a single detonation.\
\
Why you would ever need such overkill is a question best left to the practitioner's conscience.\
\
Anointable: Voiding, Heated Tool, Soft Touch, Fortunate, Fortunate II.

The infernal anvil where Spiritus is shaped into power.
Hellfire Forge

The [#](8B0000)Hellfire Forge[#]() stands as a second pillar of the art, twin to the [#](8B0000)Ara Vitae[#]() itself. Where the altar works with [#](4A0080)Essentia Vitae[#](), the Forge consumes [#](8B0000)Spiritus[#](), reshaping raw malice into [#](8B0000)Sentient Tools[#](), [#](8B0000)Spiritus Gems[#](), [#](8B0000)Arcane Ash[#](), reagents, and many things besides.\
\
No practitioner of [#](4A0080)Vitaemancy[#]() can progress far without one.
Hellfire Forge

Crafting in the Forge spends the [#](8B0000)Spiritus[#]() held in its [#](8B0000)Spiritus Gem[#](). Left to itself that reserve would soon run dry, so the Forge draws upon its surroundings: a gem seated in the Forge steadily drinks [#](8B0000)Spiritus[#]() from the chunk's [#](4A0080)Aura[#](), at the same pace a [#](8B0000)Vas Maleficum[#]() would fill it.\
\
[#](2E8B57)Feed the local Aura with a Crystallum Fractura farm and the Forge can craft unattended, its gem refilling as quickly as it is spent.[#]()
Drawing from the Aura
A sentient multitool whose ranged beam mines straight to your inventory.
Lex Vitae

The [#](8B0000)Lex Vitae[#]() is a sentient multitool that chops, mines, digs, and tills, drawing on the [#](8B0000)Spiritus[#]() you carry to do its work. Like other Sentient equipment it grows stronger as you feed it Spiritus, and may be repaired with Crystallized Spiritus in an Anvil.\
\
[#](2E8B57)Sneak + right-click to toggle the Lex Vitae between dormant and active. It only works while active.[#]()
Lex Vitae

While active, hold the [#](8B0000)Fire Beam[#]() key to project a lance of will from your hand that reaches far beyond your normal grasp. Whatever it mines is sent straight into your inventory, so nothing is lost across the distance.\
\
Sneak + scroll to widen the beam's [#](8B0000)mining radius[#](), carving out a larger area with each strike.\
\
[#](B8860B)The Fire Beam key is unbound by default; assign it in Controls under the Neo Vitae category.[#]()
The Beam

Press the [#](8B0000)Cycle Mode[#]() key (L by default) to change what the beam affects:\
\
- [#](8B0000)Mining & Damage[#](): mines blocks and strikes creatures. The default.

- [#](8B0000)Mining[#](): only mines blocks; the beam passes harmlessly through creatures.

- [#](8B0000)Damage[#](): only strikes creatures; the beam ignores blocks.\
\
The current mode is shown in the Lex Vitae's tooltip.
Beam Modes
The binding wand that weaves Routing Nodes into networks.
Node Router

The [#](8B0000)Node Router[#]() is the weaver's needle that stitches your [#](8B0000)Routing Nodes[#]() into a coherent network. Its use is straightforward; hold sneak and right-click on one node, then do the same to another within 16 blocks. The two are now linked.\
\
[#](2E8B57)Right-click any other block to deselect. See the Routing Nodes entry for the full picture.[#]()
Node Router
A slender wand of bound Spiritus. Unremarkable in appearance, indispensable in practice.
